Cooking up new adventures for her in this new era, throwing her into increasingly tricky moral quandaries, and testing her resolve (alongside some familiar faces) has truly been like playing in the ultimate sandbox. Our favorite chaos agent is back, and I cannot wait to share what we've been working on and for you all to see Gabriel's incredibly dynamic art.|Cherish Chen|}} '''''Star Wars: Doctor Aphra – Chaos Agent''''' is a [[2025]] [[canon]] ongoing [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series written by [[Cherish Chen]] and illustrated by [[Gabriel Guzman]]. The [[Doctor Aphra – Chaos Agent 1|first issue]] was published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[June 18]], 2025. While advertised as an ongoing comic,{{InsiderCite|232|Launchpad}} the series ended with [[Doctor Aphra – Chaos Agent 5|issue five]] on [[October 29]], 2025 even though the listing for the [[Star Wars: Doctor Aphra – Chaos Agent (trade paperback)|series trade paperback]] had suggested it would run for at least ten issues.{{PenguinComics|url=book/?isbn=9781302963224|text=Star Wars: Doctor Aphra - Chaos Agent}}
